prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create zealot-a.png, an HD hand-drawn fighting game animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use the attached master-side.png as the locked character design reference: match the stern clean-shaven square-jawed man's face, conical burnished steel helmet with short nasal guard, armor, white muddy wool cloak, white tabard with golden sunburst at left breast, grey mail sleeves, leather gloves and belt, steel greaves and brown boots EXACTLY. The LEFT forearm carries the same large round white wooden shield with gold sunburst and steel rim; RIGHT hand carries the same straight steel arming sword with brass crossguard. Preserve weapon and shield dimensions across all drawings.

Output exactly 1536x1024 landscape with a genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard illustration. Exactly EIGHT separate full-body figures, TWO rows of FOUR, equally spaced in four 384-pixel-wide columns and two 512-pixel-high rows. No other figures. Same character scale in all eight cells, as large as fits with generous clear gaps for cutting; all head/helmet, cloak, shield, sword and boots inside each cell. Shared foot baseline at approximately y=490 for top row and y=1000 for bottom row. Reference defines proportions, keep consistent uniform sheet scale. All eight face LEFT in profile/slight 3/4, enemies to the left. Each is a genuinely different drawing, no mirrored/repeated poses.

TOP ROW left to right WALK cycle advancing LEFT, shield raised in front on the left, sword ready low at his side:
1 left boot forward (toward left) heel contact, right boot back;
2 passing, right leg swings past supporting left leg, weight raised;
3 right boot forward heel contact, left boot back;
4 passing, left leg swings past supporting right leg, different leg positions from frame 2.

BOTTOM ROW left to right:
5 GUARD STANCE slight crouch behind raised round shield toward left, sword drawn back OVER his shoulder.
6 BLOCK IMPACT shield jolted inward by a blow from LEFT, torso recoils toward right, sliding back a step, knees flexed, gritting teeth; no attacker or effects.
7 GUARD BROKEN shield arm knocked wide open toward his own right, shield displaced away from front to expose chest, off-balance lean, surprised face, sword still held in right hand. Face remains LEFT.
8 TAUNT tall upright, sword extended horizontally with tip pointing LEFT accusingly at enemy, shield lowered, stern accusing face.

Style exactly the reference: Streets of Rage 4 spirit, confident dark brown near-black ink, thicker silhouette and thin interior lines, clean 2-3-step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded colors, lightly baked upper-left key and cool right rim. No pixel art, no 3D, no photorealism, no chibi. Correct anatomy two arms, two legs, two booted feet, five fingers per hand (may be occluded by gloves/grip). Cloak muddy hem consistent. No blood/gore, no dust, no motion lines, no effects, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, labels, borders or frame numbers. Real transparent background.
